You can also help us Anthropologists with our own research! If you complete all of my assignments I promise that you'll be generously rewarded. I've heard recently some explorers were complaining that our tasks are too difficult. Well, why don't we find a solution beneficial to everyone?
I will sell you trophies and valuable resources required to complete two tasks. You can support our research in a way you like better.

Hello there! How can I help you?
May the great Tensess be with you!

This ritual will teach you to be a bearer of true power - that of love, mercy, and faith. May you be a mirror of all that is good in this world! May the word of Tensess be with you! May the Light embrace you! And now... you may go!

Everybody has sinned. Even Tensess says in his Testament, that "there is no single creature in the world who never violated any virtues. May this not become an obstacle on the way to the enlightenment! Everyone can abandon the old sins and let the Light into their souls by saying: Nay to Evil, I Praise the Light!"
Here you are, you have come and said the words to receive the blessing of the Light. May those who was harmed by you, forgive you, as the Light has long done!
Go in peace now.
In the name of the Light, I am now marking you with sacred oil... As this oil is pouring the mercy of the Light is covering you forever and ever!
How is the delivery of that letter going?
Lost, huh... Fine, I got a couple spares. Here. Don't lose them!
Are you sure you want to bind to this location?
Oh, there's no place to play hide-and-seek in this city...
Did you know our birthday is coming up soon?
Oh... an early birthday gift! How touching! Hurray! Hurray! Time for a celebration!
Ah, are those for us? They're so nice! Thank you! We're so happy!
We want to make a scene... we know, we need some Orcs! They're pretty violent!
Flowers? For us? We asked for an Orc! Well, we guess flowers are nice too... thanks!
No one loves us... Nobody pays us any attention...
Flowers! They've noticed us! Someone is interested in us! Hurray, what a happy day!
Life is a wonderful thing! There's always something interesting going on.
See, our words are true! We've been given some flowers! We were right - life is good!
Giving presents is a way more pleasant than receiving them!

t: We have this entire land to ourselves - except for those miserable druids and animists.
I think this place would be kind of boring if it weren't for the new dangers in the swamp.
This is a great place to show the druids who's superior.

quests: Creatures of the Forest: Primal Boars

t: This is not just any forest. This is our wonderful forest! Appreciate and take care of it.
This land is starting to become a dangerous and inhospitable place. To the east of here are the shamans, our worst enemies.
This strange sphere is obviously attracting the Architects' attention. Soon enough we will have to repel another attack.

The sphere is buzzing and radiating dim blue light. It certainly has something in common with the Architects.

Maybe, we should give it a good kick to attract the attention of our uninvited guests?
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...

Hello, hello!
Want a refreshing cocktail? Or do you need some exhilarating drink to make your blood run faster? Anything you like!
Or maybe you'd like to take part in our Tipsy Marathon and win "The Drunkest Runner" title!
Aha! I can see interest in your eyes! I knew that the marathon would intrigue you!
Hey, pal! Wanna take part in the "Tipsy Marathon"? You'll enjoy it even if you don't win a prize!

Tipsy Marathon? You're a sportsman, that much is obvious!

The bartenders are still making cocktails for the next marathon, so go take a walk and come back later.

Clear your head before the competition!

Oh, that's our favorite sports! We are good at running, but the most fun is trying to run when your legs stumble and everything doubles in your eyes. So much more challenging!
Point is, we have seven bars here at the Atoll, and you have to drink a cocktail in each.
The more drunk you are when you come to the bar, the more points you get! So drink bottoms up and run fast to the next bar, while the alcohol is still in your brain. If you manage to drink cocktails at all seven bars, you will receive the prize of a drunk marathoner!
Where do you get cocktails? There are two options. You can either buy them from bartenders, or pick up fruits and mix drinks yourself. You can learn cocktail recipes from me.
Oh, and there is a rule on our island: alcohol is prohibited unless you are participating in the Tipsy Marathon. Stay sober if you don't want to return early!

Drink it in one gulp and run to the next bar!
One.
Two...
Three!
Feeling dry? We'll fix it in no time! What would you like?
Blue Lagoon... Propeller... Hurricane... Sounds like a music to my ear!
Don't feel like collecting components yourself? I see. Choose whatever you want!
Hello! Do you want to enjoy the most spectacular and reckless gambling game of our island? Welcome to Crab Racing!

Choose a track to bet. Come on, there are no losers in crab racing!
You can change your mind before the race starts.

There is not much to tell, really.
Choose the track for your crab and place your bet. When the race starts, just stay close and cheer up your crab when you can. Our racing crabs are fierce beasts, they are agile and very voracious. The best way to cheer up a crab is to throw it some Delicate Crab Feed. You can find and collect this delicacy at the bottom of the sea.
When the race is over, come back to me and get your prize!

1st place - 12 Seashells,

2nd place - 8 Seashells,

3rd place - 6 Seashells,

4th place - 4 Seashells,

5th place - 3 Seashells,

6th place - 2 Seashells,
Already leaving? I hope you enjoyed your holiday. Come back soon!

For now we need to recover our strength and gather allies!

Tep is more cautious and less arrogant now: he won't rush into someone else's trap - he'll set his own. So rushing headlong into danger is a bad idea.

My sister has connections outside of Sarnaut and she's going to use them.

We... must be vigilant. Tep has never acted alone. He will probably try to revive his cult, gathering what's left of it.

Looks like it. The last time he returned, the great necromancer tried to stir up trouble in the League and the Empire.

Yermolai's death, the troubles after the Great Ball, Skulnar's first "death", the accident in Lab 13... Sounds familiar? Tep was behind it all.

Many nurse a grudge now, so it will be hard for him to find allies. Last time he relied on Armando and his minions from ZIT Headquarters... But we dealt with the vampires, and the Empire has caught plenty of moles over the past years.

Who, then?

Catherina? After the debacle on the Eclipse, the great sorceress learned some sense - she will not ally herself with an obvious madman.

Elves? The ruined Great Ball and the "vampire problem" did not earn him any friends among them. The vampires themselves were also disappointed in Tep.

The Sculptor? He didn't throw Tep out of Ferris for nothing...

And to Cosmos he is as much an enemy as Nihaz and Hirkalla.

His only allies are pariahs like him, madmen and maniacs. But thanks to our joint efforts, there are fewer of them... I wish my sister stopped resurrecting everyone indiscriminately...

Whoever is out there will hardly be happy about competition for divine power.

Even at the peak of their power, Nihaz and Hirkalla did not completely subjugate the Domain of Death; it has its own deities appointed by the All-Mother. The same rulers of death as Hirkalla originally was, these powerful entities will not accept anyone's dominion over them. Tep will spend some time fighting them...

In the absence of Hirkalla and Nihaz, after we dealt with the Architect, Light and Chaos came to the fore.

The Light is represented by the heralds and servants of Enod, but Chaos... Nihaz tried to subjugate it, too... but is it possible to subjugate the antithesis of order itself?

If Tep decides to act outside of Sarnaut, Chaos will make things difficult for him.

Hardly!

Tep will definitely come up with something we don't expect!

There are enough problems even without him - my sister's reign has shaken the foundations of the traditional alliances; the League and the Empire are weaker than ever; and the newly resurrected are looking for their place in this world.

Smoldering old feuds will be reignited - so you will be busy.

We need to understand what we can achieve with the resources of Sarnaut... Personally, I want to figure out this system of Seals and Keys. Perhaps the very structure of our prison world can be used to protect it.

The tropical atoll! Since you're already here!

Sometimes there's no point in rushing anywhere - the problems will find their way to you. If you want my opinion, the troubles will start with those my sister carelessly resurrected... We don't even know who exactly was resurrected...

Wow, a Black Pearl! What a treasure!

Fine, that was probably too much. Don't worry! It may very well be a rarity, especially since the pearl oysters were almost cleaned out by the divers. Pearls are now hard to find on this atoll.

I just don't want you to pin your hopes on artifacts and jewelry. I used to have a few, but they didn't help me much. At some point, I was left with literally nothing - everything I had was taken from me.

The real treasure is something that can't be taken away.

Ah, yes.

"She has gathered her secret powers – seven of them.

Gripped them in her hand.

Laid down her secret powers at her feet.

On her head is the crown of Eden, Shugur.

On her brow is an enchanted headband.

In her hands are signs of dominion and judgement.

An azure necklace hugs the neck.

A double pendant adorns the breasts.

Golden bands wrap around the wrists.

The breasts are covered with a mesh.

The thighs are covered with a cloth, the attire of queens.

Kohl lines the eyes.

Inanna goes to the underworld."

And then these jackal-headed bastards say,

“Humble yourself, Inanna. The laws of the underworld are omnipotent! Inanna, be silent during the underground rites!"

I mean, undress and go through the security frame...

It's no fun...

Would you look at that! Congratulations! And you want to hear another story? Well, well, I won't keep you waiting!

So, you must be wondering why Nihaz needs demons.

From his point of view - they are an ideal tool, adaptable enough to change it as necessary. We often forget that Nihaz has limited means - he is not Sarn who can create new races for the purposes he needs. However, what he learned to do masterfully is to change someone else's creations.

And Sarn created creatures who consist essentially of the primary Astral, and you can mold them into anything.

Where did Nihaz go? I can't say for sure: the records of the Citadel are too extensive for me to reread them at once, but I remember that Nihaz had many interesting worlds in mind. Some of them lay far from our collection of worlds, separated by a space whose size is hard to imagine.

I remember that he spoke about some kind of luminaries and a strange creator, the essence of which he did not understand... I believe sooner or later we will learn more about this story.

Bravo!

Well, another achievement means another story.

You are probably wondering why Nefer Ur needs a Control Cube?

You see, Zem found themselves in a very interesting position. They are immortal, in the sense that they do not grow old and do not die. However, time plays against them - final death is actually possible for them.

The paradox here is that the "mortal" races are likely to outlive them. Each dead Zem means there are fewer of them.

Nefer Ur wants to fix this. To create a world where Zem will truly live forever.

Tep's world of illusion was "almost" real. Nefer Ur's world will be as real as Sarnaut.

Oh, wow...

Speaking of bubbles, don't you think those bubbles are similar to our worlds? Come to think of it, they don't last that long by divine standards. One can understand Nihaz who did not like that.

You were also not ready to face the end of the world on Horizon, no?

But even if Nihaz is right about this, his methods are not something that should be taken as an example...

Since we are talking about world bubbles, here's my next story for you:

I see many of you disagreed with what the All-Mother told you...

But think about it - in her eyes, all living things have the same value.

At first glance, it seems logical to you to create worlds with no predators where all living creatures can peacefully coexist. But if everyone eats only plants, then the number of animals will grow faster than plants, and soon the animals will die of hunger. In such a world no new creatures should be born, it will be static and stagnant.

In a real, living world, everyone is needed - predators, plants, those who feed on air and the juices of the earth, and those who eat flesh. Those who devour the bodies of the dead and those who cause wood to rot.

The faster this cycle goes, the stronger Life is.

My sister will create a nightmarish world frozen like a fly in amber.

An excellent achievement!

But I need to say something about this... something that will be important to you.

Well... You are probably still wondering who was the madman the Children in Eden were talking about. Oh, don't be surprised. Catherina told me everything that happened to you.

Catherina didn't know who the madman was. But you and I do.

Yes, that's right. The one we accidentally brought back into the world while trying to find the Key of Order. Tep. The madman is Tep, how can there be any doubt?

And my evil, corrupted sister resurrected him in a new body.

You must be wondering if we are going to meet him. Certainly. This is our destiny.

Hooray! I wonder who comes up with these funny tasks? I want to have a talk with them.

But you expect stories from me...

Maybe about other worlds? Those bubbles?

No, I'm not going to tell you how in some other world progress and science ruined everyone's life. There are no universal recipes. I'm aware of that.

Someone lights artificial suns, uses their power as a weapon and incinerates everything. Elsewhere in the world, two fools brandish artifacts they have dug up and destroy their world. But if you stay in your pen like a sheep, afraid that wolves lurk outside, it won't make things better.

Our mages also nearly destroyed Sarnaut, but they also saved it.

You mortals have always surprised the gods. Even Nihaz - now he is interested in some other mortals in another distant world.

Ahem. Alright, fine... I didn't tell you which achievements will impress me...

So what should I tell you... Oh, Ambrosia...

You probably think it's... not from your world. But it's not true! The one on Suslanger came from Sarnaut... the Sarnaut that changed after you and the others ruined everything!

The Ambrosia is a gift, not a curse. But some gifts are worse than a curse! Even now, it tempts you... drives you mad... A perfect resource. An energy source and a healing force. Can it return Sarnaut to its previous state? Yes. Can it help us defeat Nihaz? Yes!

But at what cost?

Are you talking about the one on Suslanger?

It appeared thanks to me. When the All-Mother was captured, I used the already created Gates-3 to try and change the past - to prevent you from ever going to Eden. As you can see, it didn't work out. But during my journey, the Gates released some of the energy of Life - there is so much of it in Sarnaut now - into the past, and it became that very Ambrosia.

Now let's consider how you became a "Weaver" and what it means.

I think it's because Destiny has an opponent.

Destiny is predetermination.

Its opposite is Luck, chance.

And not without reason. There is Order and Chaos, Light and Darkness. Opposites exist. The forces of the demiurges are Creation, Life, Destruction, Death.

There are probably forces that stand above them. Another four. And there are Chance and Predestination – two of them.

They, of course, are not gods or demiurges. They are Forces...

At some point, Chance intervened in the action of Destiny and disrupted its plans. I suppose it was the moment when you escaped from the collapsing Clement's Tower moment when you escaped from the collapsing Clement's Towermoment when you escaped from the collapsing Clement's Towermoment when your ship was nearly destroyed in battle with the League and the octhulhumoment when your ship was nearly destroyed in battle with the League and the octhulhumoment when your ship was nearly destroyed in battle with the League and the octhulhumoment when you escaped from the Thicket of the Primalsmoment when you freed yourself from the demon's curse...

Your original destiny was probably death... You were not destined to survive. But you did survive, and now you are disrupting the plans of Destiny. It's impressive.

Congratulations... I hope the poor crab is not too exhausted?

Well, a deal is a deal! What would you like to know? About the gods, maybe?

Nihaz's twelve seals. Twelve Dragon Keepers. Twelve Powers. There's a reason for that!

You must understand that there's an hierarchy behind all this. Nihaz is the God of Darkness. Sarn is the God of Light. The Architect is the Deity of Order. Every facet of divinity has someone that embodies it. Which means there are as many gods as there are facets.

That's a good question!

It all depends on what is considered power. The Twelve Domains are the All-Mother's creations, but can everything that exists be attributed to them? I don't think so.

However, if such powers really exist, then they control even the gods and demiurges.

Why?

You expect me to sit in the pioneer camp all day? It's nice here - warm water, activities... So I came by to see what's new around here!

I see no reason why we wouldn't meet here in a year.

Yes, you can visit me.

Here we have endless summer like in the pioneer camp.

The version you met in this cave is me in the future. My future. But for you, it's already in the past.

Perhaps that version won't even happen to me. Just an anomaly. After all, you and I are changing time: you just told me about my future, and I might decide not to go into that cave.
Ah, those versions from the future. Always with the spoilers! Well, yes, it's true. What's the point of denying it now.
Well, what can I say? You already know me well. I'm not very perceptive at times. What else do you know?

Ahaha, looks like someone is doing some digging. Well, there is no point in denying it, even though the goddess Inanna and I are completely different persons. Inanna is dead, you know. When I entered my sister's realm, I lost my divine status and immortality. Nihaz helped me get them back.
I told you not to go to Eden. Didn't I? And this is just the beginning of your troubles.

And you will. This, alas, cannot be avoided.

Perhaps after speaking with her, you think Nihaz and Hirkalla are right. You WILL have a chance to see what the world looks like when my sister is free to do whatever she wants.

Unless, of course, we can escape the future I came from. And it's less and less likely. Keep praising Nihaz, and you will get what you're asking for.

Why do you think he's my favorite "Daddy"? Not because I like him.

Nihaz does help many people, but his gifts are... rotten. When I became Klavdia, I lost my memory... of what happened before. It wasn't until you gave me the heart of the dragon - back in the cave on Kirah - that I was able to remember.  And get myself back. I will never forget it. And believe me, my feelings for you are more than sincere.
I've said it before - I don't want to break our time continuum even more. It has enough holes in it already. You've seen enough to know that I'm telling the truth and that you can trust me.

Oh no, it's a prediction. It's much better than whatever Sagrey, Barisheva, Unn or Cassandra can give you. I have witnessed what will happen. And this is your fate, woven by the Weaver herself. We are all just toys in her hands - it doesn't matter whether you're a god or a mortal. Fate will a have a good laugh regardless. I'm in a fight with her that apparently can't be won.
It's no longer important whether you trust me or not. What matters is what you'll do... We just have to wait.

From yours, stupid!

Games were eventually over.

Well, I told you this would happen, didn't I? Look around. The All-Mother is imprisoned, our world is being devoured by shadow woods, Hirkalla rules over everything.
Am I not supposed to be?
Hmm, interesting. However, everything is simple...

I don’t remember saying that...

But wait. Where could I have said this?
Hmm, interesting. However, everything is simple...

You're such a bore.. Why do you care about this "device"...

It will turn up! Don't worry, what needs to happen will happen!
No, just have fun. Enjoy yourself! There are no tasks here - only what the locals can offer you!

Ugh, if everyone was a little better at understanding clues, we'd have no problems at all. I couldn't speak plainly. Time is a dangerous thing. And fate is even more dangerous. You had to make your own decisions.

Well, I won't be able to give you any more clues - the future is hidden for me from now on, so I'm in the same position as you. And what's worse, I feel that someone else has entered the game.
Do you even know if it's safe? Other worlds, hah. I wish I could see them... But... You don't get it!
Someone really doesn't like what we are doing. It's not my sister, although she can cause a lot of trouble. Have you been to Jigran yet?

To you, everything that's happening seems strange, but nothing is simple in this world. One day, the truth will hit you like a sledgehammer... I'm just afraid it might happen too late.

However... There's something I can tell you! But I need to believe you're willing to make an effort to learn something new. If you want to get a Revelation from Alice, you'll have to run around for a bit... Such a small revelation. An answer to a couple of questions of existence.

Impress me. At least here, on the Tropical Atoll!
Don't dawdle. But maybe it's better if you stay away for now - I found people there who can really piss off my sister. By the way, don’t really count on the signal you sent...

Pfft. Your naivety amazes me.

Don't believe the gods, especially the gods of Light and Order. They love "saving" everyone and inflicting happiness, but will you enjoy it? Was there not enough judgment in Eden?

Inis will arrange a show trial for you here, after which all the living will be isolated for a million years, so that other worlds do not get subverted... So it's better if we do things our own way.

Actually, it's simpler than that. Enod has been here for a long time.

How do you think...

Do you think they are all blissfully unaware over there? They have been watching you for a long time. From the moment we killed the Architect, maybe even earlier. After all, the Architect came here at my signal. The Light, of course, also saw the signal and sent its scouts. Then a way to access the Fractal was discovered, then the Star Gates, and then we built a portal ourselves, and someone has infiltrated our world.

All in all, Sarnaut is no longer the closed place it used to be.

She wanted to be freed, yes.

But I don't think that "brother" Eton and "sister" Nemia will rush here headlong. They have their own war. Of course, sooner or later they will come. However, the gods do things in their own time. Sarn, the poor fellow, waited a very long time before something changed. All in all, it is not worth hoping they will arrive tomorrow.

Nothing for now.

I want to understand who else has entered the game... And you... If fate does take you to Jigran, then you will see for yourself what Hirkalla's desires have led to.

Nice, not many can do that!

I guess you're wondering where the girl Alice came from?

You don't believe the story of the young exobiologist? That stings! It's a nice legend.

Alright, I'll admit it: I actually followed a white rabbit and fell into a hole! Or stepped through a mirror? Still don't believe me?

What if me and the other pioneers are just the spawns of this mysterious pioneer camp, stuck in a time loop? And we're doomed to relive the same shift over and over again? Nice try, isn't it?

In truth, you had the answer in front of you this whole time.

Yes, there aren't many red-haired sorceresses in Sarnaut...

Perhaps Rysina, but I'm definitely not Rysina.

Congratulations! And now you are excitedly waiting for the next story!

So what can I tell you? The story of the first Great Mage, perhaps?

Elleken has always been fascinated by dragons, and thanks to you and me, he now has the opportunity to find answers to all his questions. Most likely he will go to the world that gave birth to the Void Dragons. But do not think that dragons are a rarity in the universe. You are all created in the image and likeness that is recorded in Eidos, and that includes dragons. The gods often prefer the images of humans, but also the images of dragons. Yes, there are dragon gods, and it is rumored that one such god with their Draconid servants poses a considerable threat to other worlds. Elleken and Sturegga might try to find them... Why? What do you think?

Elleken, like many others, seeks divine power. The ability to reshape reality to his liking. To finish what he started - to bring the change to the end, to transform all existence into the ideal of Beauty, the apotheosis of which are dragons.

Wow, wow! Congratulations! I bet you are waiting for another story! It's amazing!

So you're probably wondering if Catherina and Felix were right in thinking that the Ambrosia could put mortals on an equal footing with the gods?

And I see you won't relent...

Well, there is some rational thought in this - like the Xadaganian saying that if someone does exercises every morning, they can handle a gang of pirates with their bare hands.

But we both understand that there are many other factors, right?

The Ambrosia is materialized divine power. The astral energy of a high order, one might say. But the Astral is not quite contained, so you clearly weren't ready for that.

But what's done is done, and now we have to consider the consequences. And there will definitely be consequences. I'll list the obvious ones:

Firstly, everything in Sarnaut will bloom and grow, and when I say everything, I mean literally everything. Such an excess of energy means it will be used by those who lacked strength before - the ancient gods, all sorts of outcasts and maniacs, monsters, demons, and other riffraff.

Secondly, it's doubtful you'll be able to use this power wisely. Catherina has had some sense talked into her, but what about Felix with all his ambitions?

Thirdly, the Ambrosia itself is also changing: in Eden it was a beneficent force of life, but here in Sarnaut it's changing - we saw that on Suslanger. It has already spawned a crystalline form and shadow woods, and it doesn't look like it will stop there.

Ooh... You're on a dark path...

Fear... Hatred... It all leads to my sister.

She wasn't always like this... But her black heart has long turned to stone... You will have the opportunity to see for yourself - when you serve her, helping her implement her vile plans...

Well, you heroes rarely consider such questions! One can promise you a good reward, and you are willing to do anything!

Yes, there is nothing good about it! And doing tasks for this Erfar... it's demeaning.

But maybe you and I can use that to get to my sister. She is far from omniscient. As am I, by the way, so don't expect me to never be wrong.

Anyway, if you can worm yourself into her good graces, we can use that.

Let's think for a bit, shall we? Where did Nihaz go?

We need knowledge about whatever is going on out there. Fortunately, thanks to the Gates, we now have such information in abundance.

Of course, not everyone can understand the true plans of the God of Darkness. Even Hirkalla does not know everything, and I'm chained to Sarnaut, so I can't see much with my own eyes.

Fortunately, I was able to communicate with the Children, Waterlily in particular, as well as with members of Catherina's Expedition who explored the spaces around Eden.

So what did you manage to achieve there?

Yeah, I think I heard the noise! Well, I hope you're better hero than singer!

Let's talk about... crime! It bothers me... maybe some criminals stole the Chronophone?

As you can see, everything is complicated on Suslanger. Since Nezeb's time, there has been an underground organization, this Brotherhood of the Last Shelter... There's also the famous Court of Miracles, a gathering of spies, beggars and thieves all reporting to the Gray Prince.

Someone you know has recently visited Suslanger - Victoria Korleone. She was trying to reach the Gray Prince, so she organized underground fights that even blighted creatures from Umoir took part in. You disrupted her plans, and the Brotherhood dealt with the rest of the drug mafia on Suslanger.

Sevia, which is her real name, is quite a rogue.

Of course, she is not that loyal to Nezeb, but he is her only chance to attain eternal life. And mortals, as you know, don't really enjoy dying.

By the way, don't expect Nezeb to resurrect like the rest. His Spark wasn't in Nihaz's box - it's still in the deep Astral. Like Skrakan and many other Great Mages of the past who died in the first years after the Cataclysm.

Well, that's quite an accomplishment, isn't it?

I'm going to tell you a secret: the first guy I fell for used to do that - breed all sorts of creatures. A simple shepherd from one small country... But it doesn't matter!

I had to sacrifice a lot back then, and I'm afraid I'll have to do it again... As for you, just appreciate the fact that you have a choice. A wonderful world that offers a great number of opportunities!

Whose past? Inanna's? She died behind the gates of Ganzir. She is not me. The Klavdia you knew is a child of Sarnaut, its soul incarnated in the body of a mortal but long-living sorceress. I had to go from mortal to goddess again, and even then... I don't have as much strength as I had when I was the goddess of love and life in Urga.

Excellent! It means you can always slink away in time! I'm kidding!

Let's talk about time... Time is an unusual thing. You have already traveled in the time stream and you know some of the rules. Everything is simple here: there are things that can be changed and there are those that, alas, can no longer be altered. Basically, the second category includes the events that concern you personally. No matter how hard you try, you can't change YOUR past, only someone else's. But there are exceptions to any rule. By influencing someone else's past, you can ensure that the one who was changed can influence your past. Hard to comprehend? Perhaps Unn would have explained it better.

It depends on what you mean. If you are talking about its direction, then it's part of Destruction, universal entropy. What was it... "An isolated thermodynamic system spontaneously passes into a state of thermodynamic equilibrium over time and remains in it for an indefinitely long time if the external conditions remain unchanged." That is, any flame dies out, and any wind subsides.

But if we talk about time "in general", then it's just a direction, like up and down...

Ah, this competition...

You must be wondering - what do we do about Hirkalla? What does my truce with my sister mean?

Well! I'm ready to bury the hatchet with her, but that doesn't mean I trust her... She is cunning, and we must remember that she will stab us in the back if it suits her!

She is weaker now - she has lost control over her minions, and even the undead on Jigran have reportedly escaped her grip.

But she still has the entire system created by Nihaz and his servants. And of course, some still believe her. Those she resurrected and put into her service. Many are genuinely loyal to her.

And I will have to do something about it...
Hello! Sun, air, and water are our best friends!

Well done... Flying is useful!

Let's talk about the Astral! So what is the Astral? A building material for the gods? A destructive substance that turns everything into primordial chaos? Some alien crap?!

No. The Astral is alive and sentient. Think about it. Where did all these distortions and reflections come from? These are its dreams. Our Sarnaut Astral is not like other Astrals! It's not yet fully aware of itself, but it's close to it...

You will ask: how is this possible? I don't know. Who knows, maybe the reason is that this world is closed and everything is being cooked in itself. Perhaps, during the destruction of the world, myriads of living, intelligent and thinking beings died here, and their bodies dissolved in this Astral? Or is it Sarn's doing? He created beings whose flesh is the Astral. Don't forget the two gods that died here, although the Astral began to show signs of intelligence long before their death...

When the Astral fully awakens - what do you think it will tell us?

Well, for example, his copies of the islands are all stories. Why did he choose them? No one has ever asked such a question. But for some reason they seemed important to him.

He is trying to say something, but what?

Oh, is that so? Then it's time for another story.

There is something I've been reluctant to talk about. It concerns you directly. It has been bothering me since Dane.

It's about your ability to see other people's Threads and reconnect them...

Of course, as I told you then, in Sarnaut there is only one force that can change the world - an unbending will. And faith. On Irdrich, you managed to create Something from Nothing by sheer force of will and sincere faith. I thought you only seemingly "connected the Threads", but it was in fact your will and your faith. And it wasn't just you - it was everyone who believed in you.

However, after the events in Eden, people weren't as eager to put their trust in you, no? But your abilities did not seem to be affected. On the contrary, you became even more powerful.

And I was able to intervene in the past and change things. As I said, I severed the Thread of my destiny, and it's by no means a metaphor. Rather the result of the Revelation. What does it look like?

Imagine that we are all characters in some story. You suddenly find yourself outside of it, seeing everything from a different perspective. There is a book right in front of you, and you can read about the events that happened to you and have yet to happen.

And you take a pen and cross out what you don't like. But you can't rewrite the whole story, because every story has its own logic, and breaking this logic... Means losing part of what makes the story true.

It probably sounds familiar to you. After all, you saved Skulnar for a reason. You understood that this wasn't the way his story should have ended. Same with the Sharp family: you really wanted to change what happened.

But you can't rewrite the entire story! Fix something that made it what it is... This is what I ran into when I tried to interfere with my own actions.

Perhaps you would have done better. After all, your abilities are apparently much greater. This is what makes you the Weaver. Can you change history? Let's find out.

But I wonder what those "Scissors" are? And who was the author of that book?

Well, you can listen to more of my musings. You must be wondering if the All-Mother told you everything. Was she honest with you?

I'd like to know that as well. She told me the same thing... But Nihaz... He wasn't sure she was telling the truth. You probably remember his words - that gods are just children playing with toys in the sandbox while the adults are away. He said that for a reason, didn't he? Nihaz didn't share such doubts with me. So I don't know what he could have learned... I have something to think about.

The Eidoi, for starters. I'm sure they weren't created by the All-Mother or Father Time. The Eidoi were given to them. By someone. There are things about the Eidoi even the All-Mother could not comprehend.

There's also the matter of my memories. Even gods were children once, and I don't remember much of my past. But there's one moment that emerges from the fog of the past. I don't know if it's a dream or reality. I see a fiery basin that Mother took me and my sister to. And the stern look of necessity that determined our lot. I wonder if she remembers it?

Lastly, it's whatever is happening to the Sparks. All Sparks are drawn to the Source - or so they say. But what is the Source? According to rumors, it is located in the world of Fiore, the Cradle of Creation which the All-Mother left behind when she hid in Eden. It is believed that Fiore was created by her in this eon, but I'm not certain of it. Perhaps Fiore is the oldest of the worlds, and each eon it's simply renewed, never vanishing completely. It is also important that everyone who has visited it has encountered something strange... even if it's just visions.

If I weren't chained to Sarnaut, I wouldn't mind visiting it. But perhaps it's all a trick? Only the All-Mother knows that.

That's commendable! I hope you'll find it useful.

Have you ever heard that everything around us is just an illusion? And I'm not talking about Tep's stupid tricks.

But imagine that many things that seem natural and normal to you are just reflections of your own perception.

Time... There is only a moment between the past and the future, as sung in one Xadaganian song, but it's true... There is no past, since it has already passed, and there is no future yet - it's not determined by our actions and thoughts.

They say the gods see time differently. For them, time goes not only forward, but sideways... This is the meaning of the concept of "eternity". When you pass through it, you go to the past. Or an alternative present. Yes, this is exactly how the Observatory functions, and other "time machines" - they just make a door that goes sideways.

But real demiurges think in large-scale terms. For them, besides "sideways", there is also down and up. The third dimension of time that leads to the realm of being that holds everything that is, was and will be - everything possible and impossible, what comes true and what remains unfulfilled.

Think about it when you have time. Just don't hurt yourself trying to understand it.

Ugh, it's hard to explain.

You know, in Eidos they talked about existence...

When we say "existence", we mean everything that exists in the world around us. Everything we can see, touch and feel - it exists, and it's real. Sometimes instead of "existence" they use the words "world", "universe", and others. It is important to understand that these concepts are not identical despite the overlapping similarities.

But there is also non-existence...

There are several points of view on the existence of non-existence. One of them tells us that non-existence is a "negative existence" - when we talk about something that does not exist, and the complete absence of anything.

And perhaps it's the other way around, and only non-existence is real. Every moment of our life instantly recedes into the past and becomes non-existence. No matter how hard we try to escape non-existence, and no matter how quickly existence passes, everything will eventually cease to be.

Well, let's consider what we know now.

There is a force that changes other people's fates - it takes the form of "Scissors". First it was the Architect, then a certain Aisa... The Scissors do not seek to bring something new, they only eliminate the changes caused by someone's intervention. In this case, yours.

Why yours? You are the Chosen OneChosen One - that much is clear. Oh, don't scowl. But there's no reason to rejoice either. You see, I think you were... ahem... "chosen" because of your mediocrity.

What else do we know? Once upon a time, Fate let the gods draw lots. Each god is tied to their fate. They cannot become something else so as not to harm themselves. Sarn tried - and where is he now?

What surprises you? For some reason the Gibberlings know the state of affairs in our universe better than anyone else. Why? One can only guess.

I wish I could solve all the mysteries of this world...

You're probably wondering what Tep learned that drove him insane... What music of the universe does he dream of?

Well, I can't understand the workings of this sick mind...

But our old friend was always fixated on immortality - and therefore, on divinity. Becoming a god was his dream. As for the rest...

The fact that he managed to come to an agreement first with the Architect, and then with Aisa means that he envisions some kind of new Order, a universal predetermination. In it, Tep will be at the very top, with his loyal followers below him and the rest of us at the base.

It's a sick and vicious Order, an evil and unfair Predetermination. It's his Dream. He does not want destruction, he wants to make everything... "right".

Let's think some more about the mysteries of Destiny. We know little - that's a fact. Who can know more?

Nihaz? Sarn? The All-Mother?

I'm sure Nihaz only vaguely understood the true state of affairs, and he wanted to fix it. Hence his attempts to gain the power of creation - to escape the fate imposed on him. He is still looking for answers to his questions somewhere out there.

Sarn? He probably knew a lot. After all, he is the god who crossed the threshold of the cycle when worlds were destroyed and recreated. I suppose that's where the knowledge of the Gibberlings comes from - it was somehow passed on to them from the Creator. Sarn created a sanctuary for his avatar who traveled around Sarnaut in those years, somewhere in the far north of the world.

The All-Mother? She probably knows much more. I've long suspected that we haven't been told everything. Oh, these secrets... I would like to have a frank conversation, but I doubt she will talk to me about it...

Right...

My thoughts in this area are purely theoretical... We don't know much, but I can summarize what we managed to learn.

But each such conversation requires payment: if you achieve something, we'll talk.

It's good that you are happy about such things, otherwise I'd be worried the hardships of saving the world deprived you of simple pleasures!

World Mysteries...

I hope you enjoy learning new things. One of the latest mysteries: what happened to Ath-Zak and Lua-Jalla? You are probably interested in the period of their history after they defeated the Curse and said goodbye to Tka-Rik? And before they became nothing but Sparks in Nihaz's greedy hands?

Well, some day this story will be told. But not by me. Hey, don't make that face... I don't know everything. What can a simple exobiologist know?

Fine, I'll tell you what I know. As you can imagine, this story is rather sad... Zak and his princess had a son... And this son refused to stay at home. He started traveling. One day he met this innkeeper, whose daughter was kidnapped by some villains... Zak's son decided to save that daughter... And then, like in all fairy tales, a happy ending... But no. The guy got into big trouble. The kind that forced his parents to intervene. They made a deal with the innkeeper, became his students. He trained them until they realized they didn't want whatever he was offering. They wanted to break the pact... but I told you the story was sad, didn't I? They failed. But at least they saved their son.

Not all stories are destined to be heard...

Although... Perhaps you will have a chance to ask the participants yourself?

You don't think I used Ath-Zak's Spark and the rest of the Junes as batteries, do you?

Not many deserve a happy ending, but Ath-Zak does...

Excellent!

I would like to discuss current politics with you.

The League and the Empire. The long rivalry seems to have come to an end. Cosmos twisted the League's arrogance and the Empire's pride into a knot of a new alliance.

The new enemy forces them to stick together. Now it's Nihaz, later it might be Cosmos himself... But will the alliance hold together for years?

You doubt it? So do I. Perhaps there'll be new alliances eventually?

Well, no one rules forever.

However, you should not be sad. Conservatism and fear of change will keep them going for a long time. Perhaps they will still have time to fight each other.

The friendship that until recently seemed to hold them together is quickly fading, don't you think?

Congratulations! So you are expecting another story, am I right?

Who else are you interested in? Herbert and Elena?

These two always wanted to travel. And Sarnaut became too small for them. I think they now have the opportunity to see an infinite number of very different worlds and forget about the stupid feud between the League and the Empire.

You definitely don't have to worry about these two. Herbert is a capable mage, and Elena is a master of espionage and disguise, so they can easily worm their way into any community. On Eden, they probably already knew what they would do in these other worlds.

I honestly don't know whether they will return or not, but perhaps sooner or later they will get homesick and look for a way to come back.

I expected something like this when we decided to open the Star Trail. The people of Sarnaut will be able to leave it, but will they all return? And it's not just me. Aidenus and Yasker probably wondered the same. Remember:

"We would have probably succumbed to temptation and set off to conquer new worlds. The Empire would have grown too big and gained too much power. And then?"

"The Gibberlings would have found themselves a new land. The great Elven houses would have sprung up everywhere, then quickly withered due to lack of challenge and competition. As for the Kanians, they would've lost their roots, forgotten their ancestors and their faith... "

They are partially right... Who knows what awaits us?

Oh, the joy! Congratulations! There you are, waiting for another story...

You are probably wondering what Hirkalla's forces are like, since we are going to fight them.

Dear sister has changed little over the years since we parted ways. Yes, and she could not change - the fate of the gods is set by fate itself. Unlike mortals, they are doomed to their lot.

Hirkalla was originally the goddess of death, but she wasn't very important. She was entrusted with one of the rustic worlds, Urg. It wasn't the best place, and even then she wanted more. She tried her hand at "creation", but she only succeeded at making monsters.

Then Nihaz led her astray, promising a change in the universal order and an opportunity to escape her lot, but even now things remain the same. Hirkalla became the goddess of darkness and death. She merged them, filling death with darkness and darkness with death. All this makes the current eon what it is - when mortals are afraid of the night.

Nihaz's rebellion has caused mortals in many worlds to reject the commandments of the All-Mother and choose their own path. However, this did not increase the number of his followers.

Such is Nihaz's rebellion - it's not a war where Light and Darkness stand face to face. Light and Darkness not fight in people's souls.

However, the God of Darkness also needed troops, a kind of secret army that appears and disappears quickly, ready to stab someone in the back when needed. Thus the inner worlds were devastated, because Nihaz was able to gain the powers that he later turned into the Seals that held Sarn. Then Hirkalla became Nihaz's blade.

She has numerous relics of past eons at her disposal, like the creature that you and Skulnar met on the Star Trail. Darkness did not create them, only distorted what was created by others.

The most dangerous of them are known as husks, monstrous creatures that feed on the energy of Sparks. Hirkalla is able to give them what they crave.

Cool!

Perhaps that's the symbol? Remember that even in the darkest time, you can find a place where hope still lingers. The ancient seas became the seas of the Astral, but there are still lands that haven't been discovered. Maybe you'll find something new there?

So remember, believe, keep searching, and never give up. There is always hope.

Oh, was it a difficult riddle? Few people bother to try and guess. You have become incurious, and that's bad.

Did you like the homeland of the Gibberlings? I think you did. But it sounds like no one enjoyed the cold.

Well, maybe fate will take you to Isa again. Some things were left unfinished, which means someone will need to finish them.

And if not you, then who?

Bravo! But let's talk about something important...

I suppose you are interested in the aspects of the demiurges' powers... Life, Death, Creation, and Destruction. Each of them is the reverse side of the other facet and an integral part of the overall cycle. Life creates Death. Death creates Life. Creation leads to Destruction. Destruction leads to Creation.

You don't fully understand Sarn's Gift to his last children. What is Destruction?

The essence of Destruction is entropy. The fire goes out. The wind dies down. The water dries up. The mountain turns to sand. Destruction leads to balance. The essence of Destruction is inevitability. The real name of Destruction is Time.

Time is the great Destroyer. Only Creation can oppose it. The will of Creators, Demiurges, Founders of Worlds.
Ahaha, what can you do? But now you understand what time is...

In this private cabin you can change into a beach suit - the one you have with you, or into an exotic native outfit.

Or you can strip down and show off your swimsuit or underwear!

To use the cabin, you need to pay 1 regular or faded seashell.

Any swimsuit or beach outfit is best!

Almost any costume, headwear or decoration from Jack Cheap will do.

Some outlandish outfits are also appropriate: Tropical Attire, Antient Hickut's Loincloth, Beach Wear, and corresponding headwear. Beach outfits from the Boutique would also look great!

We also offer all guests a colorful native outfit to rent!

What would you like to change into?
This portal will teleport you back to the Crossroads
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
What happened with the first one? Next time please be careful.
I'll give you another one, but you have to charge it with the Ashes of the Past.

Do you know how to challenge a Destroyer? You will need a Ritual Knife. If you don't have one, I can give it to you.
Find a Demonic Portal, then cut your wrist and shed some blood on it. The Destroyer will scent your blood and come to you through the time.
At first you will have to fight weaker demons, but once they understand they can't cope with you, more powerful enemies will appear.
It's highly possible that they have the item you need.
Which artifact in particular would you like to exchange?!
Use the knowledge you have received wisely!
Use the knowledge you have received wisely!
Use the knowledge you have received wisely!
Use the knowledge you have received wisely!
So you are saying you can kill demons? Is it true?

Okay. Show us!
We'll be glad to see if you are telling the truth.
Here I am. It's not quite "me", though - this is my twin.
Yes, everything is fine. The charm works. Go back to the camp, we need to talk.
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
Greetings, ! What would you like to know?

The Day of Knowledge, one of the most respected holidays! There are few aspirations as lofty and beneficial as the desire to acquire and apply new knowledge, and to deepen the existing one.

It is difficult to describe our joy that you have decided to spend this day here.

See the stairs behind me? Climb them to get to the hall where all performances will be held.

If there is one in progress, then hurry up, take a seat, and enjoy the show!

You can also engage other participants in conversations or enjoy the local views.

One of the islands of the Dionic Archipelago - the concentration of all sports, arts and sciences! This is the native land for us, the Aoidoi, and our capital is located not far from here. It's the most peaceful place in the whole of Sarnaut.

You're a guest here and you don’t know much about it, but trust me - many great heroes stood where you are now. Perhaps one day you'll want to become one of them...
Greetings! Here you can purchase various ship devices and hire goblins.
Wonderful! What generation are you interested in?

Greetings, ! If you seek adventures in the unknown, you are a good fit for the Imperial Fleet! Every day we launch new campaigns to explore Astral sectors and strengthen our position there. You will find our current directives on my table.

Greetings, ! If you seek adventures in the unknown, you are a good fit for the League! Every day we launch new campaigns to extend our knowledge of Astral sectors and increase our influence there. You will find our current tasks on my table.

Ethereal thread is a best-selling goods. It is produced from ethereal crystals, there is nothing stronger than that! They use it for ships' rigging and sails, so we are flooded with offers from both League and Empire. Baccy Family or Michael Kazakin will gladly buy all ethereal thread you can deliver.
One reel of the ethereal thread is already loaded to your ship. Would you like anything else?
Where are we going to load it? You couldn't even fit a box of chocolates in your hold, to say nothing of a container of thread!

No, the product is expensive, we do not sell more than three chests per person. The astral is a dangerous place, anything can happen. So, ask someone on your team top pay for the additional cargo and accept all the delivery risks.

Welcome to the Factory Allod of the Free Traders! Here we produce durable Ethereal Threat from Ethereal Crystals

The Ethereal Crystal warehouse is {raw} full, the Ethereal Thread warehouse is {prod} full, total storage capacity is {capacity}.

Great, I've written it down. Anything else?
Hey, mate, your hold isn't elastic! There is no more space!

We don't give more than three containers to any one person! By order of management! Although... Money always comes in handy. Alright, let's do it this way. If you want to take more onto the ship, let someone else from your crew buy more containers from me! Only remember, you will not get the profit from selling the container of solution - the one who bought it will.

Welcome to Free Traders' trading post!

I am glad to inform you that we have reached level {level} of productivity.

Pure etherium storage is filled by {raw}, ethereal solution storage is filled by {prod}, and total storage space is {capacity}.

We buy pure etherium at {buyPrice} and raw etherium at {buyPrice2}. We sell ethereal solution at {sellPrice}.
Fine! If you happen to find more etherium, bring it to us.
Excellent! If you have more etherium, bring it to us, we will by it all!

Okay, I am putting this down: one barrel of raw etherium has been sold... What is your name?
Aha, that's what I'll write.
For raw etherium you will receive a good price at any trading post of the Free Traders, where they can process it. The etherium gathered by collectors in the allods is impure, unlike the stuff collected using an astral trap during a demon hunt... but then it is less risky.

We don't give more than three barrels to any one person! By order of management! Although... Money always comes in handy. Alright, let's do it this way. If you want to take more onto the ship, let someone else from your crew buy more barrels from me! Only remember, you will not get the profit from selling the barrel of raw etherium - the one who bought it will.
Hey, mate, I can't do that! You need a ship and some free space in the cargo hold!
Got it. Deliver the ethereal crystals to our factory, and you will be paid. Anything else?
No, your hold is already packed, it is bursting at the seams!

We do not hand over more than three containers of ethereal crystals to one person! If you want to pack your ship to the rafters - then get someone else from your crew to organize the purchase, to be responsible for it and to share the profits from the sale with you.

Welcome to the Manufactory of the Free Trader!

We have hit production level {level}.

The Etherium Solution warehouse is {raw} full, the Ethereal Crystal warehouse is {prod} full, total storage capacity is {capacity}.

We buy Etherium Solution at a price of {buyPrice} and sell crystals at a price of {sellPrice}.
Excellent! Just what we needed. We are in a constant shortage of ethereal solution, you know.
We have everything for the heroes that help the people of Sarnaut fight off the threats of the unexplored Astral.
